narrative.human_title: All Card Calendar — Pikachu leaves a blank for the human
narrative.why_it_matters: This is one of the clearest early places where Pokemon cards stop being only creatures and become social forms. The blank in _____'s Pikachu is the magic: a card title waiting for a person, a birthday, a calendar, a little ritual of ownership. Kagemaru Himeno's softness matters because the card is not trying to roar. It is making space.

narrative.human_title: _____'s Pikachu — the card with a place for you
narrative.why_it_matters: A lot of Pikachu cards are famous because Pikachu is famous. This one is different. _____'s Pikachu is famous because the card asks for a human to complete it. The blank-name field is tender and dangerous at the same time: a birthday ritual, a condition question, a provenance mark, a personalization trap. That is exactly why the catalog has to care.
